columns.comment: Document presentation id (instrument id + presentation number).

columns.comment: LC the documents were presented under (join gold.fact_trade_finance_transaction).
columns.name: txn_id

columns.comment: Sequence of the presentation under the LC (1 = first).
columns.name: presentation_no

columns.comment: True for the LC's first presentation (one row per LC - use for per-transaction measures).
columns.name: is_first_presentation

columns.comment: True when the documents were re-presented after a refusal.
columns.name: is_re_presentation

columns.comment: Timestamp the documents were received by trade operations.
columns.name: received_ts

columns.comment: Date the documents were received (the grain date).
columns.name: received_date

columns.comment: First day of the month of received_date.
columns.name: month

columns.comment: Timestamp the examination was completed (null while pending).
columns.name: checked_ts

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Import LC or Export LC.
columns.name: product_type

columns.comment: PRD-IMPORT-LC or PRD-EXPORT-LC; join gold.dim_product.
columns.name: product_id

columns.comment: Booking location of the LC (ISO-2).
columns.name: booking_country

columns.comment: Trade operations team that examined the documents (e.g. SG Trade Ops Hub, VN Trade Ops).
columns.name: ops_team

columns.comment: Amount claimed under the presentation in USD.
columns.name: amount_usd

columns.comment: Hours from receipt to completed examination (null while pending). Use the median over examined rows.
columns.name: turnaround_hours

columns.comment: Examination SLA in hours (24).
columns.name: sla_hours

columns.comment: True when the examination took longer than the SLA.
columns.name: is_over_sla

columns.comment: True once the examination is complete (decision is not Pending Examination) - the denominator of the discrepancy rate.
columns.name: is_examined

columns.comment: True when the documents were found discrepant (false for complying and pending).
columns.name: is_discrepant

columns.comment: Number of discrepancies found (0 when complying).
columns.name: discrepancy_count

columns.comment: All discrepancy types found, semicolon-separated.
columns.name: discrepancy_types

columns.comment: Main discrepancy (e.g. Late Shipment, Inconsistent Data Between Documents); None for complying presentations; null while pending.
columns.name: primary_discrepancy_type

columns.comment: Complying, Discrepant - Waived, Discrepant - Refused or Pending Examination.

columns.name: is_waived

columns.comment: True when the presentation was refused.
columns.name: is_refused

columns.comment: LC amendments made on or before the date the documents were received.
columns.name: amendments_before_presentation

columns.comment: All amendments of the LC (instrument attribute repeated on each of its presentations - sum it only over is_first_presentation rows).
columns.name: txn_amendment_count

columns.comment: Client's discrepancy rate over its examined presentations received Apr-Sep 2026 (client attribute as of 30-Sep-2026; null below 3 presentations).
columns.name: client_discrepancy_rate_h1_fy2026

columns.comment: Client's discrepancy rate over its examined presentations received Oct-2025 to Mar-2026 (client attribute; null below 3 presentations).
columns.name: client_discrepancy_rate_h2_fy2025

columns.comment: True when the client's discrepancy rate rose by 10 points or more from H2 FY2025 to H1 FY2026 (>= 3 examined presentations in each half) - an early-warning input.
columns.name: is_client_discrepancy_rising

comment: One row per LC document presentation examined by trade operations (import and export LCs) from May-2023: received and checked timestamps, turnaround hours vs the 24-hour SLA, discrepant flag with discrepancy count / types / primary type, decision (complying, discrepant - waived or refused, pending examination), re-presentation flag, amount, operations team and booking location, LC amendments made before the presentation, and each client's discrepancy-rate trend (H1 FY2026 vs H2 FY2025) as an early-warning input. Discrepancy rate = count_if(is_discrepant) / count_if(is_examined); median turnaround over examined rows; Amendments per Transaction = SUM(txn_amendment_count WHERE is_first_presentation) / count distinct txn_id. Grain: one row per document presentation (presentation_id).
